scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-caste Marriage Assistance Scheme-II
other_conditions: Both spouses must belong to a backward class or most backward class community
The bride must have passed the 10th standard
If the bride belongs to a scheduled tribe, she must have studied up to the 5th standard
The bride must hold a degree from a regular college, distance education institute, or a government‑recognized open university
The applicant must hold a diploma from an institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
The application must be submitted before the child of the couple turns three years old
benefits_summary: Provides a total financial assistance of ₹50,000 to the newly married couple (₹30,000 via ECS, ₹20,000 as a National Savings Certificate) along with a 22‑carat gold coin (1 sovereign).
